acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: When you have some power, but not a lot, how do you wield it when you’re suddenly cast into the spotlight?

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Zoe Chace and Ben Terris follow Abbas Alawieh as he fights to broker a deal at the DNC – a way to potentially satisfy the people who voted “Uncommitted” in the primaries as a protest vote against Biden’s handling of the war in Israel and Gaza.
acts.credits: By Ben Terris and Zoe Chace
acts.title: The Convention

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Three weeks after the Democratic National Convention, Abbas speaks at a tense community meeting in Michigan about the Uncommitted organizers’ general election recommendation and hears back from voters on how they feel about the Democratic nominee at this point.

songs.a: Ryan Scott & “Power Moves” by Silver Skylarks (radio only)

acts.title: Back Home in Michigan
